originality.rationale: The new claim is a complete four-agent distribution of 57 priority-order-to-matching multiplicity shapes and support cardinalities, not the classical support membership or all-market RSD lottery equivalence. Full text of the 2023 motivating paper and the 1998 mechanism foundation, a related 2014 counting paper, and accessible complete same-domain mathematical census results were compared. The nearest four-agent censuses measure ordinal efficiency and probabilistic-serial dominance, which cannot determine support-shape frequencies. Available published mathematical-record comparisons and accessible historical findings found no explicit covering counts; an unindexed table remains a real priority risk.

value.rationale: Matching support is the number of complete deterministic allocations an uncertain-priority mechanism may produce, a meaningful distributional object rather than the positive entries of its marginal assignment matrix. The complete 57-shape classification is the first four-agent complement to a known three-agent five-shape census; the eight impossible support sizes, exact mean and rare large-support tail provide natural benchmarks and a full finite classification. The value is not based solely on code correctness or novel integers.
